title: Give yourself where love can be trained
summary: Love deepens when the self is offered to the Guru without reserve. Serve in a way that leaves the self quieter.
takeaway: Serve in a way that leaves the self quieter.
lifeApplication: When service starts bargaining for notice, return it to hidden love and steady hands.

source.shortMeaning: Love deepens when the self is offered to the Guru without reserve.
source.lifeApplication: When fear and doubt tighten, offer the withheld part instead of defending it.

evidence.coreClaim: Love deepens when the self is offered to the Guru without reserve.
evidence.turn: Keep this in front of you: let surrender reach the body before the ego performs again.
evidence.practicalImplication: When service starts bargaining for notice, return it to hidden love and steady hands.
